recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-layered composition featuring two large, soft-focus close-up portraits of men with facial hair at the top, transitioning into a smaller full-body scene of the same men playing acoustic instruments at the bottom against a cloudy, ethereal background.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between the dominant upper portraits and the smaller lower figures.
Seamless airbrushed blending between the dark clothing of the portraits and the central scene.
Horizontal framing provided by the top script and bottom block text.
coreInvariants: Thin red border framing the entire internal composition.
Muted, earthy color palette with a cool blue atmospheric glow in the center.
Soft, diffused lighting on the faces to minimize harsh shadows.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large heads occupy the top 60% of the frame; smaller figures are centered in the bottom 40%.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes of the two large portraits serve as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the large faces to the smaller musical scene, guided by the central glow.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, textured areas around the shoulders of the portraits provide a heavy base for the composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and dark browns in the clothing and hair.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale skin tones and a soft sky-blue glow in the center.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Thin red border and warm wood tones of the instruments.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark edges and the central light source.

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Monolinear script with long horizontal flourishes extending to the edges.
Bottom text: Wide-tracked, thin sans-serif capitals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'C' in the top script feature exaggerated loops that integrate into a continuous horizontal line.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between fluid, connected script and rigid, spaced-out geometric sans.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rule lines extending from the script

preserve: Horizontal tracking of the bottom text

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Futura Light or ITC Avant Garde
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked bottom text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of two men with 70s hair and beards in soft focus at the top, blending into a central scene of them playing acoustic instruments against a cloudy blue sky. Surround the image with a thin red border and a grey outer margin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white monolinear script title at the top with long horizontal tails. Add wide-tracked, thin white uppercase sans-serif text along the bottom edge.

verificationChecks: Are the top portraits significantly larger than the bottom figures?
Is the bottom text extremely spaced out?
Does the script have horizontal lines extending to the edges?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the central blue glow
Amount of grain/texture in the portraits
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artists
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless blending between the portraits and the lower scene.
Ensure the script text does not obscure the eyes of the portraits.
Verify the tracking on the bottom text is wide enough to span the width.
Confirm the color palette remains in the muted 70s spectrum.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine large-scale soft-focus portraits with a smaller-scale action scene using airbrushed transitions, framed by a thin colored border and high-contrast script/sans-serif typography.
